newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bank deposits rise 0.1 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bank deposits rise 0.1 pct in January.

text.p: Total deposits in Venezuelan commercial banks rose 10 billion bolivars, or 0.1 percent, to 5.018 trillion bolivars (US$10.6 billion) in January from 5.008 trillion bolivars in December, according to financial consultants Softline Consultores.
The drop in deposits came as Softline incoroporated two banks -- Banco Popular and Fivenez Banco de Inversion -- to its survey to bring the total to 40 banks.
Of the total deposits 42.9 percent were in current accounts and 35.8 percent in savings accounts. The remainder were in sight deposits and time deposits, Softline said.
Credit portfolios grew by 76.895 billion bolivars, or 3.5 percent in January to 2.296 trillion bolivars.

Among leading banks, Banco Provincial clung onto the top spot with 23.7 percent of total deposits followed by Banco Mercantil with 12.2 percent, Banco Venezuela with 9.5 percent, Banco Union with 7.1 percent and Banco Consolidado with 7.0 percent.
